bullets.text: Crypto Travel Rule Implemented — The UK's Crypto Travel Rule, effective from September 2023, mandates virtual asset service providers to enhance transparency in digital asset transactions, impacting compliance for crypto firms.

Energy Cyber Resilience Critical — Europe's energy sector faces heightened cyber threats, necessitating robust cyber resilience strategies to safeguard energy supply and maintain public trust amid geopolitical tensions.

AI Governance Evolving — Singapore's Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) is shifting towards evidence-based AI governance, requiring financial institutions to demonstrate compliance with new risk management guidelines by 2026.

UK Retail Disclosure Changes — The FCA's new Consumer-Centric Investment (CCI) regime, starting in 2026, aims to enhance retail investment disclosures, impacting how firms communicate product information to consumers.
Capco Expands in Canada — Capco has launched a dedicated energy practice in Calgary to support clients in navigating changes in the energy sector, reflecting its commitment to industry growth.
